GPU-accelerated iso-surface extraction for PyTorch An iso-surface is the set of points where a 3D scalar field equals a chosen value: the shape described by a signed distance function, or the boundary of a density volume. Fields like these come from neural networks, simulations and scans, while most tools consume triangle meshes. isoext is a growing collection of iso-surface extraction methods ...
